page_title: GEN 1-0 SAL | Genoa v Salernitana 27/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Stefano Sabelli.

90+1' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
86' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) for his blatant foul.
82' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

82' What a great touch by Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
80' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) picks up a long through ball, but Josep Martinez deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jovane leaves the pitch and Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) comes on.
77' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Davide Massa who sees an offensive foul.
76' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
70' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' The ball is cleared after Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi comes onto the pitch after Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Giulio Maggiore as he is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
64' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
59' A substitution has been made. Ruslan Malinovsky is replaced by Berkan Kutlu (Genoa).
59' Here is a change. Milan Badelj is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Strootman (Genoa).
57' Josep Martinez reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Junior Sambia (Salernitana) towards the left side of the goal.
55' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
54' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make a change. Mattia Bani is unable to continue due to injury, Koni De Winter (Genoa) comes on.
52' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
51' The foul by Morten Frendrup (Genoa) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
49' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
48' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Filippo Inzaghi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana). He is replaced by Junior Sambia.
46' Filippo Inzaghi makes a switch. Emil Bohinen is coming on in place of Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Mateo Retegui. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Davide Massa starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' A dangerous looking corner kick from Radu Dragusin (Genoa) is cleared to safety by the defence.

43' He should have scored! Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Guillermo Ochoa makes an easy save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mattia Bani (Genoa) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
37' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
37' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Ruslan Malinovsky slips it to Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.

34' Excellent touch by Boulaye Dia (Salernitana)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
29' A lofted cross from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
27' A clumsy foul by Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) and Davide Massa blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
26' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
24' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
21' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

17' Milan Badelj (Genoa) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
17' OFF THE POST! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
15' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
10' Milan Badelj (Genoa) sends a long ball forward to Stefano Sabelli, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
9' A cross from Jovane (Salernitana) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
4' Milan Badelj (Genoa) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the right post and ricochets away!
4' It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
3' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Genoa win a corner.

3' What a save from Guillermo Ochoa! Radu Dragusin (Genoa) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
2' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
